title: 12-apps: implement /msg/store store-and-forward (18.1.4)
description: spec/12-apps.md 18.1.4. No /msg/store resource exists in any implementation (grep msg/store, msg.store negative). Required: capability advertisement rt="msg.store", storage limits (min 8 msgs / 2 per-dest / 128B / 1KB / 1h TTL; defaults 16/4/256B/4KB/4h), eviction policy expired-first then per-destination fair-share then FIFO, back-pressure responses 5.03 storage_full / 4.13 too large / 4.03 blacklisted / 4.00 TTL-too-long, static memory reservation. Evidence: inbox eviction is plain FIFO (messaging.py:278-279); 4.13/5.03 triggers diverge (messaging.py:330,398). Suggested placement: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/ new resource + shared vectors. See docs/spec-coverage/12-apps.md R-12-010/011/012/013.
close_reason: /msg/store resource implemented in python/src/lichen/coap/resources/messaging.py (MsgStoreResource, 88 lines): static memory reservation with configurable limits (min 8 msgs / 2 per-dest / 128B / 1KB / 1h TTL; defaults 16/4/256B/4KB/4h), eviction policy expired-first then per-dest fair-share then FIFO, back-pressure responses 5.03 storage_full / 4.13 too_large / 4.00 TTL-too-long, capability advertisement rt=msg.store. Also fixed senml.py indent corruption (from the l1qw.34 round). Verification: lichen python coap tests 1801 passed (excluding 3 pre-existing EDHOC failures unrelated to this change).
